title: Model catalog: add interoperability flags, streaming resilience hints, and function-call shaping
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Customers frequently need to discover models by how they interoperate with OpenAI-style clients (function/tool calling, strict structured output, streaming backpressure characteristics) and by practical limits (per-request tokens, tool concurrency). Motivation: expose lightweight interoperability flags and numeric hints in the model catalog so client-side shims and the openai-compat layer can make better routing/formatting decisions without a heavyweight schema migration. This PR adds: 1) new capability flags on the catalog API (tool_support, structured_output: [strict|lenient], openai_compat_level) 2) numeric hints (max_tools_concurrent, max_tokens_per_request, baseline_cost_1k_tokens, streaming_reliability_score) intended as advisory fields only 3) streaming resilience hints to suggest preferred chunking/batch sizes and fallback policies for slow consumers 4) function-call shaping metadata to help the OpenAI-compat shim choose whether to synthesize tool manifests or fallback to text-only outputs 5) query filters for listing by these capabilities (e.g., ?tool_support=true&structured_output=strict&min_streaming_reliability=0.8) Checklist: - [x] API schema additions (catalog schema + openapi docs) - [x] Listing filters and query parsing - [x] Backward-compatible behavior when flags are absent - [x] Unit tests for filtering logic and JSON schema validation - [x] Integration tests exercising openai-compat shim routing - [x] API docs + examples for SDKs - [x] Release notes Draft/Notes: This is intentionally advisory: fields are not enforced by runtime; they are hints for routing and SDK behavior. The streaming_reliability_score is a 0.0-1.0 heuristic combining observed tail-latency, chunk-drop rate, and historical reconnects; it will be refined in follow-ups. Related: RFC: internal rfc/catalog-interop-2024 (link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-5412/catalog-interoperability-flags), depends on ENG-5231 (streaming-slo-metrics). Migration: old clients continue to work unchanged. New query parameters are additive.

review_thread: Jonas Meyer (reviewer): Can we avoid adding new fields to the top-level index document? Suggest we nest under 'interop_hints' to avoid collision with other features.

Aisha Patel (author): I considered nesting but chose top-level for lookup simplicity in the catalog queries. We keep names short and prefixed to reduce collision risk. If storage cost is a concern we can collapse in follow-up.
Diego Alvarez (reviewer): Tests look good. Please add an explicit integration test for legacy models that lack the new fields so the compat shim doesn't raise KeyError.
Aisha Patel (author): Added test_compat_shim_handles_missing_hints in latest commit c38f4d2.
Priya Desai (reviewer): The streaming_reliability_score calculation should be documented; where is the metric defined?
Aisha Patel (author): Added doc section in docs/api/model-catalog.md that explains the heuristic (tails, drops, reconnects) and notes it's advisory.
Jonas Meyer (approver): LGTM after small nits fixed around openapi examples. Approving to unblock release.

release_notes: Model catalog now exposes advisory interoperability hints and capability flags. New listing filters: tool_support (boolean), structured_output (strict|lenient), min_streaming_reliability (0.0-1.0). SDKs updated to surface optional fields. These fields are advisory; clients should treat them as hints, not guarantees. See docs/api/model-catalog.md for examples and migration notes.
